question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word 'obscene' from the following sentence.**

Vijay was suspended from duty because he gave dirty and prejudiced remarks to his female colleagues in the office.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Dirty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the word '**obscene**' from the given sentence is: **Dirty**.
 
• The word '**obscene**' means offensive or indecent, often relating to explicit or offensive sexual content.
 
• In the sentence, the phrase "gave dirty and prejudiced remarks" indicates that Vijay made offensive or indecent remarks.
 
• Therefore, '**dirty**' is the synonym that closely aligns with the meaning of '**obscene**' in this context.
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• The comedian made **obscene **jokes during his performance.
 
• The movie was rated R due to its **obscene **language and explicit scenes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Suspended**: This word does not have a similar meaning to 'obscene.' 'Suspended' refers to being temporarily removed or barred from a position or duty.
 
• **Prejudice**: This word refers to preconceived opinions or biases and is not synonymous with 'obscene.'
 
• **Colleagues**: This word refers to people who work together and is not related to the meaning of 'obscene.'
